measurement.centering: for each r,a,y and then q: scale by max(abs(v)); center by arithmetic mean; reject zero scale or centered L2 <=1e-12 times scaled uncentered L2; normalize centered vector to unit L2
measurement.control_matching: same raw sources, paired sessions, common support, rank transform, positive dose and missing handling; control is never promotable
measurement.correlation_roundoff: clip only excess no greater than 64*float64_machine_epsilon to [-1,1]; larger excess makes both unavailable
measurement.historical_series: inherited price vintages and estimated Top32 plus assumed theme17 historical membership proxy
measurement.initial_partial: exact_incumbent; measurable raw_followthrough/raw_control and ranks may remain in audit; common support false
measurement.missing: both raw values unavailable and both deltas exactly zero for any missing/nonfinite/nonpositive consumed source, near-constant vector, dependent controls or residual degeneracy; no fill
measurement.nuisance_estimation: within-window intercept and two-control partial correlation only
measurement.population: current original49 pool including ETFs; current trading eligibility and all original27 arrays remain unchanged
measurement.prices: exactly aligned adj and volume DataFrames from pinned local panel; no raw close; slice official windows before numeric conversion; no source outside consumed windows read
measurement.q: product of centered unit-L2 r_s and centered unit-L2 a_s; then center and normalize q to unit L2
measurement.rank: separate average ascending percentile minus .5 for followthrough/control on shared finite original49 pool including ETFs before trading eligibility
measurement.raw_followthrough: dot(unit_residual_q,unit_residual_y); Pearson partial correlation with intercept controlling r and a
measurement.residualization: Gram-Schmidt: b=unit_a-dot(unit_a,unit_r)*unit_r; reject L2(b)<=1e-12; normalize b; for unit_q and unit_y subtract projection on unit_r, then projection of that residual on b; reject residual L2 <=1e-12 and normalize
measurement.score_inputs: both deltas already include the complete dose

selection_contract.choice: volume_followthrough only if every incumbent and matched-control guard passes; otherwise incumbent_local67; persistence_control is never selected
selection_contract.guards_apply_to: followthrough vs incumbent: same_close requires .005 CAGR gain and next_open_5bp is noninferior; followthrough vs persistence_control: both same_close and next_open_5bp are noninferior; every comparison uses the same Sharpe/drawdown/era guards
selection_contract.source_support: all structural and missing-neutral validation passes; coverage is reported without a threshold

source_limitations: Estimated historicalTop32 plus assumedtheme17, not certified all-US PIT membership or authorETFlist.
Later-retrieved adjusted-price vintages and reused developmenthistory; not pristine OOS.

Stored share-volume is heterogeneous across sources, splits and splice conventions; not true turnover, orderflow or proof of informed trading. Constant volume-unit changes cancel in log deviations, time-varying vendor changes may not.
This is a conditional refinement of prior signed-volume/next-return family; missing original source files limit novelty certification.
Daily interaction correlation is not a causal estimate and need not predict monthly returns.
